 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Showbiz Showbiz PBB: Robbie Jaworski revealed as house guest 
 By GMA News Published November 8, 2026 5:31pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photo: Pinoy Big Brother Robbie Jaworski was revealed to be a house guest in " Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0 ."
 On Sunday's episode of the reality series, Kuya was shown telling Robbie during his first day that he was not an official housemate.
 Instead, he would be Kuya's collaborator and he would lead the first Big Charity mission for this edition.
 Since then, Robbie found out that he was not the only collaborator: he was joined by Mikee Quintos , who helped him construct a mini PBB house in secret to win P10,000 for charity.
 Other Stories
 Mikee Quintos, Robbie Jaworski spark kilig in 'Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0'

 'PBB Collab 3.0': Meet Gehlee Dangca, 'Ang Darling K-Pop Idol ng Las Piñas'
 They were given another secret task a week later: to teach Anthony Constantino and Nicole Fortuna how to pronounce, comprehend, and translate the lyrics of the PBB song "Pinoy Ako" by Orange and Lemons.
 Robbie and Mikee were allowed to recruit two more collaborators, and they picked Primo Alterado and Lans Nagal .
 Anthony and Nicole were later quizzed by Kuya, and they answered 15 out of 20 questions correctly. That meant the collaborators won P15,000 for charity, putting the total prize to P25,000.
 While accomplishing the Big Charity missions, viewers noticed the strong chemistry between Robbie and Mikee . Their tandem was dubbed RobKee.
 "PBB: Collab 3.0" premiered on Saturday. Sixteen housemates , composed of celebrity personalities, social media stars, and ordinary netizens, entered the new PBB house.
 The reality series airs on GMA Network from Mondays to Fridays at 9:35 p.m., Saturdays at 6:15 p.m., and Sundays at 4:45 p.m. —MGP, GMA News
